# @stackline/find-parent-dir

> Maintained, zero-dependency `find-parent-dir` compatibility package with
> callback, sync, Promise, CommonJS, ESM, and TypeScript APIs.

Install:

```bash
npm install @stackline/find-parent-dir
```

Keep historical imports:

```bash
npm install find-parent-dir@npm:@stackline/find-parent-dir
```

- Documentation: https://alexandro.net/docs/vanilla/find-parent-dir/
- Migration: https://alexandro.net/docs/vanilla/find-parent-dir/guides/migration.md
- Compatibility: https://alexandro.net/docs/vanilla/find-parent-dir/guides/compatibility.md
- npm: https://www.npmjs.com/package/@stackline/find-parent-dir
- Source: https://github.com/alexandroit/stackline-find-parent-dir
